subject: hermes-agent
tagline: Self-improving AI agent with built-in learning loop; skill creation, agent-curated memory, cross-channel CLI

modules.name: agent
modules.description: Core agent loop, context engine, prompt builder, memory manager, model adapters

modules.name: gateway
modules.description: Messaging gateway with 19 platform adapters (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, Matrix, Email, SMS, Home Assistant, WeCom, WeChat, Feishu, etc)

modules.name: hermes_cli
modules.description: CLI entry + setup wizard + OAuth + doctor + gateway subcommands

modules.name: tools
modules.description: 63 tools (browser, code exec, file ops, delegate, cron jobs, memory, skills, MCP, session search, image gen, mixture-of-agents)

modules.name: tools/environments
modules.description: 6 terminal backends: local, docker, SSH (base), daytona, singularity, modal/managed_modal

modules.name: optional-skills
modules.description: 15+ opt-in skill categories (autonomous agents, blockchain, creative, devops, email, mcp, migration, etc)

modules.name: plugins/memory
modules.description: 8 memory backends: byterover, hindsight, holographic, honcho, mem0, openviking, retaindb, supermemory

modules.name: batch_runner.py
modules.description: Batch trajectory generation / RL data collection

plugins.mechanism: plugins/ with plugin.yaml manifest per backend (memory + context_engine)

unique_selling_points: Self-improving agent: autonomous skill creation + skills that improve during use
Built-in learning loop with agent-curated memory + nudges
Six terminal backends including serverless (Daytona, Modal) with hibernation
FTS5 session search + LLM summarization for cross-session recall
Honcho dialectic user modeling built in
Research-ready: batch trajectory generation + Atropos RL + trajectory compression
Runs on $5 VPS or GPU cluster; not tied to your laptop

limitations.description: Android via Termux uses limited `.[termux]` extra, not full `.[all]`
No native companion mobile apps (vs openclaw's SwiftUI/Kotlin)
